definition{
  name: isSemanticFailure,
  parameters: [graph : Uorc.Core.Graph::Graph],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match (Uorc.Core.Graph::validateGraph graph)
    | Result.error staticFailure => false
    | Result.ok validated => (match (Uorc.Core.ReferenceSemantics::evaluateGraph graph (nil Uorc.Core.ReferenceSemantics::Sequence))
      | Result.error failure => true
      | Result.ok unexpected => false))
}

definition{
  name: joinBoundedList0,
  parameters: [prefixValues : (List Bool), suffixValues : (List Bool)],
  result: (List Bool),
  body: (match prefixValues
    | List.nil => suffixValues
    | List.cons firstValue remainingValues => (cons firstValue (joinBoundedList0 remainingValues suffixValues))),
  recursive_argument: prefixValues
}
